scope.eligibility_rule: Retain a source only when it directly constrains a required Option B problem family and is an official standard/guideline, an original methods contribution, or primary empirical evidence. Record but do not adopt any coefficient, estimator, model, cutoff, interval, sample, instrument, item, or procedure.
scope.stopping_rule: Stop when every Pro-required problem family has at least one suitable constraint source or is explicitly classified as unresolved/later review; do not expand into a systematic review.
